heading: Is Buttermilk gluten free?
intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Buttermilk and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Buttermilk is typically made from milk and a bacterial culture, both of which are gluten-free. However, cross-contamination or the use of additives could pose a risk.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Buttermilk can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.
